description: Get the most recent official results (draw date, winning combination, complementary numbers and jackpot when applicable) of one game, newest first. Use it for questions like "what were the last Euromillones numbers?". Returns up to the 3 most recent draws.

game.description: Game slug. Call list_games to see them all. Example: "euromillones".

limit.description: How many recent draws to return (1-3).

name: get_latest_results
title: Get latest lottery results
